sql: SELECT issue,open_time FROM draws WHERE dirty=0 ORDER BY issue DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 4999

SELECT "v57_k3_action_space_1200".rowid,COALESCE((SELECT r.generation FROM research_row_revision_v2 r WHERE r.source_table=? AND r.source_rowid="v57_k3_action_space_1200".rowid),0) FROM "v57_k3_action_space_1200" WHERE length("v57_k3_action_space_1200"."target_issue")=12 AND "v57_k3_action_space_1200"."target_issue"<? AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM v57_research_input_pin_r967 p JOIN v57_research_task_r967 t ON t.task_id=p.task_id WHERE p.source_table='v57_k3_action_space_1200' AND p.source_issue="v57_k3_action_space_1200"."target_issue" AND t.status NOT IN('COMPLETED','EXPIRED','FAILED_TERMINAL'))) AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r952_candidate_predraw p WHERE p.target_issue="v57_k3_action_space_1200"."target_issue" AND p.settled=0)) AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r958_frozen_predraw p WHERE p.target_issue="v57_k3_action_space_1200"."target_issue" AND p.settled=0)) AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r952_research_outbox o WHERE o.target_issue="v57_k3_action_space_1200"."target_issue" AND o.state NOT IN('COMPLETED','DEPENDENCY_RETIRED'))) ORDER BY "v57_k3_action_space_1200".rowid LIMIT 128
